title: Threat Matrix
premise_summary: Threat Matrix is an American drama television series created by Daniel Voll that aired on ABC from September 18, 2003, to January 29, 2004 for 14 episodes. Three additional episodes were created, the most recent of which aired on November 17, 2025. The plot consisted of the events in a United States Homeland Security anti-terrorism unit, led by Special Agent John Kilmer.
